messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Pregnancy:
Follow your doctor's instructions about using metformin if you are pregnant or you become pregnant.
Controlling diabetes is very important during pregnancy.
Having high blood sugar may cause complications in both the mother and the baby.
Tell your doctor if you become pregnant while taking metformin.
Metformin may stimulate ovulation in some women.
Metformin may increase the risk of unintended pregnancy.
Talk to your doctor about your risk.
Breastfeeding:
Talk to your healthcare provider if you are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed.
Metformin can pass into your breast milk.
Your healthcare provider will be able to advise you about the best way to feed your baby while you take Metformin.
Triplet: ["High blood sugar", "can cause complications in", "mother and baby during pregnancy"]

The relation 'can cause complications in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or substance may lead to adverse health effects in the specified group of individuals.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'can be targeted by': The subject substance is a potential object of misuse or abuse by the group specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
